findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "index.php" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: wai_prompts · Private data: wai_draw_site, wai_autolisp_library, wai_official_data · Public sink: wai_official_data · Destructive: wai_calculate.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: wai_prompts · Private data: wai_draw_site, wai_autolisp_library, wai_official_data · Public sink: wai_official_data · Destructive: wai_calculate

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
